reasons: Yonah unwraps the lunch and identifies the two small fish with the five loaves; Andrew then receives the lunch with great care.
In scene 11, the fish are shared from the disciples to the crowd as part of the “there is enough” miracle.
The image of five loaves and two fish recurs on the scroll and seal, making the fish part of the story’s central symbol.
story_role: the humble lunch that becomes enough for the crowd
